title: Local Order Matters: A Lightweight CPU-Trainable CNN for Website Fingerprinting on Defended Tor Traffic
abstract: arXiv:2611.19864v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Website fingerprinting (WF) attacks let a passive adversary infer which site a Tor user visits from the encrypted cell sequence. On undefended traffic, hand-crafted-feature attacks are already near-ceiling, so deep learning offers only a marginal advantage there. We show that the decisive regime is defended traffic: against the FRONT padding defense, which injects dummy cells that corrupt the volume and count features feature attacks rely on, a compact 95,103-parameter 1-D convolutional network trained on the raw cell-direction sequence, on CPU only, stays robust while three implemented direction-only feature baselines degrade. On the closed-world WFlib FRONT set (95 sites), our model reaches 54.2% top-1 accuracy versus 38.5% for the strongest implemented feature baseline (k-FP-style RF), a gain of 15.7 percentage points (3 seeds; seed-0 paired-bootstrap 95% CI [+14.5, +17.0] pp on per-trace correctness, excluding zero). On undefended

translated_title: 局部顺序至关重要：一种可在CPU上训练的轻量级CNN，用于受防御保护的Tor流量上的网站指纹识别
translated_abstract: 网站指纹攻击使被动攻击者能够从加密信元序列中推断出Tor用户正在访问哪个网站。在未受防御保护的流量上，手工特征攻击已接近性能上限，因此深度学习在此只能带来边际优势。我们表明，决定性的场景是受防御保护的流量：针对FRONT填充防御——该防御通过注入虚拟信元来破坏特征攻击所依赖的流量体积与计数特征——一个仅有95,103个参数的紧凑一维卷积网络，仅在CPU上基于原始信元方向序列进行训练，仍能保持鲁棒，而三个已实现的方向特征基线则性能大幅下降。在闭世界WFlib FRONT数据集（95个站点）上，我们的模型达到54.2%的top-1准确率，而最强已实现特征基线（k-FP风格的随机森林）仅为38.5%，提升15.7个百分点（3个随机种子；种子0的逐轨迹正确性配对自助法95%置信区间为[+14.5, +17.0]个百分点，不包含零）。在未受防御……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 针对采用FRONT填充防御的Tor流量，一个仅约9.5万参数、纯CPU训练的轻量级一维CNN通过直接学习原始信元方向序列，比方向特征基线准确率高出15.7个百分点，证明在防御场景下局部顺序才是网站指纹攻击成败的关键。
en_tdlr: Against the FRONT padding defense on Tor traffic, a lightweight 95K-parameter 1-D CNN trainable on CPU directly from raw cell-direction sequences outperforms direction-feature baselines by 15.7 percentage points, showing that local order is the decisive factor for website fingerprinting under defenses.
